payload.message: • Hypothesis: a quality-gated steady k-omega SST solve lands the separation point within ±5% of NASA's published experiment, and shows the known model-form bias on how far downstream the flow reattaches. • Falsifier: the mesh misses its gates, the residuals never settle, or the converged separation point sits outside that band with no stated cause.

• Gate: converged separation location within ±5% of NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource, wall-mounted hump experiment. • Reattachment is reported against the same source on a wider, stated model-form band, because a linear eddy-viscosity closure is documented to over-predict this bubble's length. • Credible because the source is NASA's own maintained validation record for this exact case, both the real tunnel and NASA's own CFD.

• The mesh gates are the standard acceptance band, per OpenFOAM mesh-quality guidance. • The numerical channel carries the graded station's measured sensitivity to a fourfold refinement, with no band extrapolated from it.
